tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// phyag rgya chen po rdo rje ye shes kyi sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor las/ jo mo lhan skyes ma'i sgrub thabs dngos grub kyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so/

/na mo gu ru shrī badzra yo gi ni/ li khri'i mdangs 'phrog bden gnyis zhal gyi padmo rgyas// thabs shes zung 'jug phyag gnyis drug spyod bde skyong can// rigs lnga'i rgyan brgyan mtha' gnyis spangs pa'i gar gyis rol// sangs rgyas kun yum don gnyis mthar phyin de la 'dud// de nyid las byung mchod pa'i rim pa dang*// mngon rtogs mchod phreng slob ma rjes 'dzin rnams// rgyud dang man ngag dgongs pa ji bzhin du// 'jug pa bde bar sgrig chags gsal brjod bya// dang por bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje rnal 'byor mar bsgom zhing*/ phyag rgya chen po rdo rje ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du sindhu ra la brten pa'i dbang thob cing*/ dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas sam/ ri'i rtse'am/ dur khrod la sogs pa'i gnas/ lung dang mthun par/ yar ngo'i tshes bcu dang brgyad la sogs pa'i dus khyad par can la/ sgrub pa'i bar chad zlog pa dang*/ dam tshig nyams chags bskang ba dang*/ ḍā ki mchod pa'i phyir du/ bdud rtsis sbyangs pa'i sa la thig chog ltar thig btab/ chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum nyis brtsegs su bri/ phyogs bzhir dga' 'khyil g.yon 'khor re/ phyi rol tu rdo rje rgya gram me ri g.yon du yod pa'i dbus su/ yi ge bam̐ smug nag padma 'dab brgyad bcas pa'i dbus su mañdzi/ de'i steng thod pa bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa dar dmar pos bkab pa'i steng*/ me long la chang sindhu ra bsres pa gser gyi smyu gus bris la/ chos 'byung dpe bris ltar byas la bkram/ rdo rje/ phag mgo/ rgya gram/ ka pā la sogs phyag mtshan rnams bkod/ dbang ldan du bum pa rdzas kyi gang ba/ mchod pa mar me bdun/ lha bshos bdun/ mar zan rdog po bdun/ sha lhu bdun/ zas sna/ 'bru sna/ nyer mchod lnga dang bcas pa/ g.yas g.yon du dga' 'khyil dkar po dang chos 'byung dmar po'i steng du/

tshogs rdzas ma da na dang ba la sha sogs bshams/ rang gi mdun du lag mchod bde skyong bdud rtsis bkang ba/ ḍā ma ru dang dril bu bzhag la/ rnal 'byor pa kha nub tu u rgyan la mngon par phyogs te/ ngag tu/ rang nyid skad cig gis rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhal gnyis mar gsal bar gyur/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kunḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ kaṃ las mi mgo gsum gyi sgyed pu'i steng du/ āḥlas byung ba'i thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba/ dpral ba rang la bstan pa de'i nang du/ go ku da ha na las sha lnga/ bi mū ra shu ma las bdud rtsi lnga/ bhrūṃ aṃ dzrīṃ khaṃ hūm̐ las ye shes lnga/ de'i steng du zla ba la gnas pa'i kha ṭwāṃ ga rtse thur la bstan pa/ de'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yig 'bru gsum po de las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros/ rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol te/ kha ṭwāṃ ga las bdud rtsi'i rgyun dpag tu med pa bab/ slar yang 'od zer rlangs pa dang bcas pa phyogs bcur 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka dang*/ sbyor mtshams nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ yi ge gsum kha ṭwāṃ ga dang bcas pa dam tshig gi bdud rtsi la thim pas/ zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi kha dog dri ro reg bya nus pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum brjod/ mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni ngag tu/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas thod pa'i nang du/ hūm̐ yig 'od du zhu ba las byung zhing lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/

dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba/ rgya nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa/ dus 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du rgyun mi 'chad pa'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra pā dyaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra puṣpaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra dhū paṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra ā lo kaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra gandhaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra nai wi dyaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra shapta āḥhūm̐/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma byin gyis brlabs cing 'bul ba ni/ ngag tu/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ kaṃ las mi mgo gsum gyi sgyed pu'i steng du/ āḥlas byung ba'i thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba/ dpral ba rang la bstan pa de'i nang du/ go ku da ha na las sha lnga/ bi mū ra shu ma las bdud rtsi lnga/ bhrūṃ aṃ dzrīṃ khaṃ hūm̐ las ye shes lnga/ de'i steng du zla ba la gnas pa'i kha ṭwāṃ ga rtse thur la bstan pa/ de'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ yig 'bru gsum po de las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros/ rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol te/ kha ṭwāṃ ga las bdud rtsi'i rgyun dpag tu med pa bab/ slar yang 'od zer rlangs pa dang bcas pa phyogs bcur 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka dang*/ sbyor mtshams nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ yi ge gsum kha ṭwāṃ ga dang bcas pa dam tshig gi bdud rtsi la thim pas/ zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi kha dog dri ro reg bya nus pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral ba'i dbyings su bskor zhing*/ pheṃ/ gtor mgron phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams su bzhugs pa'i zhing skyong dang mkha' 'gro/

'byung po'i rigs su gyur pa thams cad skad cig gis bkug par gyur/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmaḥṇaṃ ādya nutpanna twatta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ā ra lli hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badzra ḍā ki ni sa ma ya st+waṃ/ dṛ shya hoḥ oṃ arghaṃ hūm̐/ oṃ pā dyaṃ hūm̐/ oṃ puṣpaṃ hūm̐/ oṃ dhū paṃ hūm̐/ oṃ ā lo ke hūm̐/ oṃ gandhe hūm̐/ oṃ nai wi dye hūm̐/ oṃ shapad hūm̐/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye nas/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yakṣa/ rakṣa sa/ bhū ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsā/ unmā da/ a pa sma ra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya dā ya i maṃ ba liṃ gṛhṇantu/ sa ma ya rakṣantu/ ma ma sarba siddhi mme pra yatstshantu/ ya the baṃ/ ya thaiṣṭaṃ/ bhuñdza tha/ pi ba tha/ dzi ghra tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kārta ya sat+su khaṃ bi shuddha ya sa hā yi kaṃ bha wantu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ lan gsum brjod nas/ zhing skyong chen po brgyad rnams dang*// mkha' 'gro sum cu so gnyis dang*// lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// klu yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// 'byung po'i tsheogs rnams ma lus dang*// yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// sha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// smyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// brjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// ma lus pa ni thams cad dag /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun 'grub cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyi stongs grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// byad stems ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*// bde legs phun sum tshogs pa yi// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog

/gang dag nag po'i phyogs gyur pa'i// gsang sngags zab mo'i cho ga la// nyan dang lta bar mi dbang ba// de dag thams cad gzhan du dengs// gal te bka' las 'da' byed na// rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ rab 'bar bas// mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas 'gyur// zhes gtor ma phyi rol du dor zhing drag sngags bzla ba ni/ oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛhṇā pā ya gṛhṇā pā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ā na ya hoḥ bha ga wān badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces ngag tu gdangs dang bcas te/ hūm̐ nyon cig bar chad bgegs kyi tshogs// lus ngag yid la gnod pa rnams// nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*// bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rab sbyor bas// rdo rje 'bar ba'i lus kyis ni// sku gsum la gnod 'joms par byed// gal te mi 'gro mkha' 'gro yis// 'jig par 'gyur ba gdon mi za// oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣṭāṃ gnod byed mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ hūm̐ nyon cig bar chad bgegs kyi tshogs// lus ngag yid la gnod pa rnams// nga ni dpal ldan 'khor lo 'chang*// bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rab sbyor bas// 'khor lo 'bar ba'i lus kyis ni// sku gsum la gnod 'joms par byed// gal te mi 'gro mkha' 'gro yis// 'jig par 'gyur ba gdon mi za// oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣṭāṃ gnod byed mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ hūm̐ nyon cig bar chad bgegs kyi tshogs// lus ngag yid la gnod pa rnams// nga ni dpal ldan ral gri 'chang*// bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rab sbyor bas// ral gri 'bar ba'i lus kyis ni// sku gsum la gnod 'joms par byed// gal te mi 'gro mkha' 'gro yis// 'jig par 'gyur ba gdon mi za// oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣṭāṃ gnod byed mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ hūm̐ nyon cig bar chad bgegs kyi tshogs// lus ngag yid la gnod pa rnams// nga ni dpal ldan padma 'chang*// bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rab sbyor bas// padma 'bar ba'i lus kyis ni// sku gsum la gnod 'joms par byed// gal te mi 'gro mkha' 'gro yi// 'jig par 'gyur ba gdon mi za// oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/

sarba duṣṭāṃ gnod byed mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ hūm̐ nyon cig bar chad bgegs kyi tshogs// lus ngag yid la gnod pa rnams// nga ni dpal ldan rin chen 'chang*// bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rab sbyor bas// rin chen 'bar ba'i lus kyis ni// sku gsum la gnod 'joms par byed// gal te mi 'gro mkha' 'gro yis// 'jig par 'gyur ba gdon mi za// oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣṭāṃ gnod byed mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭ// rang gi steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ ra ba/ drwa ba/ gur/ bla re/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba dang bcas pa bsrung ba'i 'khor lo lha mo rnams dang bcas pas bsrungs te/ bar chad thams cad zhi zhing rnam par rgyal ba'i 'khor lo chen por gyur/ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// shes rab snying brtse dang bcas pas// brtson pas sems can don du bdag /sangs rgyas mdun du gnas bcas te// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum brjod/ rang gi spyi bor paṃ las padma dang aḥlas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa dkar po hūm̐ gi mtshan pa las 'od 'phros sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas sras bcas la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las he ru kaḥdakar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas/ yum dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa'i zhabs mthil gnyis rang gi tshangs bug la gtad pa/ de'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ yig dngul chu'i kha dog can gyi mtha' mar/ yi ge brgya pa'i sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/

sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ de rnams kyi mkhyen brtse dang nus mthu thams cad bdud rtsi'i rnam par spyan drangs/ he ru ka'i thugs ka'i sngags phreng sa bon dang bcas pa la thim pas/ hūm̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun bab pas sku gang*/ sbyor mtshams dang zhabs mthil nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzags pas/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs lus gang*/ 'khor ba thog med kyi sdig sgrib dang dam tshig nyams chags thams cad dag lus sems la bde stong gi nyams myong khyad par can bdag gzhan sems can thams cad la skyes par gyur/ oṃ shrī badzra he ru ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badzra he ru ka twe no pa tiṣṭha/ ḍī ḍho me bha ba/ su to ṣyo me bha ba/ su po ṣyo me bha ba/ a nu rakto me bha ba/ sarba siddhi mme pra yatstsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsittaṃ shrī yaṃ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān/ badzra he ru ka mā me muñtsa/ he ru ko3 bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥhūm̐ phaṭ/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma yi dam/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma rnams gsal bar gyur/ oṃ badzra bhū me āḥhūm̐/ gzhi dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ oṃ badzra ri khe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri mu khyud kyis yongs su bskor ba'i dbus su/ hūm̐ ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling*/ nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ byang shar du zla ba/ lho nub tu nyi ma/ dbus su lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa/ byur bur bkang ba rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i grangs dang mnyam par mngon par bkod de/ bla ma yi dam/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

dbus kyi ri rgyal lhun po la// gling bzhi gling phran brgyad kyis skor// nyi ma zla bas bskor ba byed// gser dang dngul dang shel dag dang*// man shel dkar dang bai ḍūrya// mu tig dmar dang dung snying dang*// phun tshogs rin chen sna bdun dang*// bum pa bzang po gter gyi mchog /zhing khams rnam par dag pa 'di// rje btsun bka' drin can rnams la// bdag cag mos pas 'bul lags na// thugs rjes brtser dgongs bzhes nas kyang*// las dang sdig sgrib sbyang du gsol// kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can// srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyong ba// de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gter// gtso bos bdag la bka' drin stsol// khyod zhabs padmo spangs nas ni// gtso bo gzhan na ma mchis pas// dpa' bo rdo rje slob dpon gyi// blo mchog ting 'dzin bskyed du gsol// gu ru ratna i dam maṇḍal nirya ta ya mi/ rang nyid skad cig gi rje btsun rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i snying khar padma dang nyi ma'i steng du bam̐ dmar po las 'od zer 'phros pas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang*/ rdo rje phag mo'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa spyan drangs/ 'od zer snying khar thim par gyur/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che// rnam dag rdo rje dbang phyug dang*// rjes chags chags pa che rnams kyi// rdo rje phag mo de la 'dud// phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma la bzhugs pa'i// mkha' 'gro ma dang lā ma dang*// dum skyes ma dang gzugs can ma// mkha' 'gro chen mo bzhi la 'dud// snying ga'i sa bon las byung ba'i 'dod yon gyi lha mo rnams kyis bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin gyi mchod pas mnyes par gyur/ chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin rnam dag las// gzugs kyi rnam 'phrul sku yi rdo rje ma// gzugs mchog mchod pa dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// rdo rje gzugs mchog ma yis mnyes gyur cig

/oṃ shrī badzra yo gi nī rū pa kā ma gu ṇa badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ me long ye shes rang bzhin rnam dag las// sgra yi rnam 'phrul zhe sdang rdo rje ma// sgra snyan mchod pa dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// rdo rje sgra snyan ma yis mnyes gyur cig /oṃ shrī badzra yo gi nī shapad kā ma gu ṇa badzra pu dzi te āḥhūm̐/ mnyam nyid ye shes rang bzhin rnam dag las// dri yi rnam 'phrul yon tan rdo rje ma// dri mchog mchod pa dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// rdo rje dri mchog ma yis mnyes gyur cig oṃ shrī badzra yo gi nī gandhe kā ma gu ṇa badzre pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ sor rtog ye shes rang bzhin rnam dag las// ro yi rnam 'phrul gsung gi rdo rje ma// ro mchog mchod pa dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// rdo rje ro mchog ma yis mnyes gyur cig /oṃ shrī badzra yo gi nī ra sa kā ma gu ṇa badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ bya grub ye shes rang bzhin rnam dag las// reg bya'i rnam 'phrul 'phrin las rdo rje ma// reg mchog mchod pa dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// rdo rje reg mchog ma yis mnyes gyur cig /oṃ shrī badzra yo gi nī sparshe kā ma gu ṇa badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa tī badzra wā rā hī baṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo ārya a pa rā dzi te trai lokya mā te ma hā bīdye shwa ri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na maḥsarba bhū ta bha yā wa he ma hā badzre huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo badzra ā sa ne a dzi te a pa rā dzi te wa shyaṃ ka ri ne tra bhrā ma ṇi huṃ? hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na maḥsho ṣa ṇi ro ṣa ṇi kro dha kā ra li ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na maḥtrā sa ni mā ra ṇi pra bhe da ni a pa rā dza ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo bi dza ye dzambha ni st+wambha ni mo ha ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo badzra wā rā hī ma hā yo gi nī kā māe shwa rī kha ge huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ oṃ āḥhūm̐/

oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra shapad pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yi// de bzhin bdag gis dbang skur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pas dbang bskur/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi bor mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pas mtshan zhing dbang gi lha de rnams la thim par gyur/ de nas bum lha la dmigs nas/ mchod bstod bya ba ni/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kunḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas thod pa'i nang du/ hūm̐ yig 'od du zhu ba las byung zhing lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba/ rgya nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa dus 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du rgyun mi 'chad pa'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī arghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī pā dyaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī puṣpaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī dhū paṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī ā lo kaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī gandhaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī nai wi dyaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī shapad āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin rnam dag las// sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul lha mo mchod yon ma// bcom ldan bum pa'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul// rdo rje mchod yon ma yis mnyes gyur cig

/oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī arghaṃ pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin rnam dag las// sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul lha mo zhabs bsil ma// bcom ldan bum pa'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul// rdo rje zhabs bsil ma yis mnyes gyur cig /oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin rnam dag las// sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul lha mo me tog ma// bcom ldan bum pa'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul// rdo rje me tog ma yis mnyes gyur cig /oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī puṣpe pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin rnam dag las// sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul lha mo bdug spos ma// bcom ldan bum pa'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul// rdo rje bdug spos ma yis mnyes phyir 'bul// oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī dhū paṃ pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin rnam dag las// sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul lha mo snang gsal ma// bcom ldan bum pa'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul// rdo rje snang gsal ma yis mnyes gyur cig /oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī ā lo ke pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin rnam dag las// sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul lha mo dri chab ma// bcom ldan bum pa'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul// rdo rje dri chab ma yis mnyes gyur cig /oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī gandhaṃ pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin rnam dag las// sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul lha mo zhal zas ma// bcom ldan bum pa'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul// rdo rje zhal zas ma yis mnyes gyur cig

/oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī nāai we dye pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin rnam dag las// sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul lha mo sgra snyan ma// bcom ldan bum pa'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul// rdo rje sgra snyan ma yis mnyes gyur cig /oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī shapta pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐ stong nyid snying rje snying po che// khams gsum pa yi ngo bo nyid// bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od// rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsung thugs// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal bstod// bde ba'i rang bzhin ma skyes pa// ji bzhin nyid du rtogs gyur pa'i// gzhan don mthar mdzad pa yi// rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// g.yon pa chags sogs khro mo'i zhal// g.yas pa rtog med phag gdong zhal// bdag med skye med chos kyi dbyings// rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun rtog 'ching ba gcod mdzad cing*// 'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug pa'i// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// bde gshegs sku la gnyis med 'khril// zag med bde ba'i sku nyams ldan// sems can rnams la bde ster ma// phag mo yum la phyag 'tshal bstod// lte ba'i dbus na 'byung bzhi 'phro// chos dang longs spyod rdzogs la gnas// mkha' 'gro ma rnams sdud mdzad ma// phag mo yum la phyag 'tshal bstod// phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa'i tshogs// rnal 'byor ma la mchod par 'bul// thugs dam bskang phyir bzhes su gsol// dngos grub gnang phyir bzhes su gsol// gtso 'khor thams cad kyi thugs ka'i sa bon la sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar dmigs te bzlas so/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye badzra warṇa nī ye badzra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/

sogs bya'o/ /bum lha rnams 'od du zhu/ bum pa'i chu dang dbyer med du 'dres pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ mdun bskyed ni/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa/ rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa/ kha gdengs che ba gyen du bstan pa/ phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i dbus su/ paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ dbugs bral pho mo snol ba'i steng du/ yi ge bam̐ smug nag las 'od 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ yi dam rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid can/ zhal gnyis ma rtsa zhal khro zhal thur du gzigs pa/ g.yas pa phag zhal nam mkha' la gzigs pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ khro gnyer bsdus shing yid tsam 'dzum pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas pas gdug pa can thams cad skrag par byed pa'i gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pa bdud dang srin po la sogs pa'i khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ mchan khung na thabs mtshon pa'i kha ṭwāṃ ga bsnams pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'khyil zhing sil bu thur du 'phyang ba/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa bcu lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ spyi bor rus pa'i 'khor lo/ rna cha/ mgul rgyan/ gdub bu/ ske rags te/ phyag rgya lnga yis brgyan pa/ sgeg pa la sogs pa'i gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ sku lang tsho dar la bab cing rgyas pa/ zhabs g.yas pa'i rkang mthil gyi g.yon pa'i brla la sbyar ba/ g.yon pas ro dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rab tu mnan pa/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ chos 'byung gi zur rnams su padma nyi ma ro'i gdan la/ shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ lhor rin chen mkha' 'gro/ nub tu padma mkha' 'gro/ byang du las kyi mkha' 'gro/

thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin cing*/ gru mo na kha ṭwāṃ ga bsnams pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ g.yon rkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar rang rang gi sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ badzra sa ma dzaḥ pheṃ oṃ shrī badzra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ oṃ shrī badzra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ oṃ shrī badzra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra puṣpe pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ oṃ shrī badzra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra dhū pe pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ oṃ shrī badzra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra ā lo ke pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ oṃ shrī badzra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra gandhe pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ oṃ shrī badzra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra nai we dye pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ oṃ shrī badzra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra shapad pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta puṣpe pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dhū pāe pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ā lo ke pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gandhe pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nāai we dye pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shapad pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di rnams la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kun gyi khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/

zhes ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pas dbang bskur/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso mo la mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan cing*/ dbang gi lha rnams kyang de rnams la thim par gyur pa'i lte bar oṃ baṃ las rdo rje phag mo dmar mo/ snying khar haṃ yoṃ las gshin rje ma sngon mo/ mgrin par hriṃ moṃ las rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ mgo bor hriṃ hriṃ las skyod byed ma ser mo/ spyi gtsug tu huṃ hūm̐ las skrag byed ma ljang khu/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭ phaṭ las tsaṇḍi ka dud khaḥrnams kyis mtshan par gyur/ snying ga'i sa bon las byung ba'i sgo mtshams ma la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis dkyil 'khor pa la mchod par gyur/

mchod pa byin rlabs ni ngag tu/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kunḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ mchod yon/ zhal bsil/ bsang gtor/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ā tsa mā naṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ prokṣa ṇaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ pā dyaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ puṣpaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ dhū pāṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ā lo kaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ gandhaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ nāai we dyaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ shapad āḥhūm̐/ yan lag brgyad ldan dri ma med pa'i chab// mtsho ngom bsil la yang ba'i mchod yon 'di// bcom ldan snying po'i rnal 'byor ma la 'bul// rdo rje mchod yon ma yis mnyes gyur cig /oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī arghaṃ pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ dri ma med pa'i lha rdzas las byung ba'i// zhal bsil dam pa gaṅgā'i chu rgyun 'di// glo bur nyes pa'i dri ma dag phyir 'bul// rdo rje zhal bsil ma yis mnyes gyur cig /oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī ā tsa mā naṃ pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ sgrib gsum nyes pa'i tshogs rnams dag byed cing*// dri med ye shes ldan pa'i bsang gtor 'di// sku gsung thugs la khrus chab 'di phul bas// rdo rje bsang gtor ma yis mnyes gyur cig /oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī prokṣa ṇaṃ pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐// nam mkha'i gos can rin thang med pa'i chab// rnam par 'thor ba'i rlung gis mi g.yo ba'i// chab kyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes phyir 'bul// rdo rje zhabs bsil ma yis mnyes gyur cig /oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/

zhing khams kun tu skye zhing gnas pa yi// me tog rnam mang ji snyed mchis pa kun// sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma la 'bul lags na// rdo rje me tog ma yis mnyes gyur cig /oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī puṣpe pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐// zhing khams kun tu sbyar zhing gnas pa yi// bdug spos rnam mang ji snyed mchis pa kun// rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la 'bul lags na// rdo rje bdug spos ma yis mnyes gyur cig /oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī dhū pe pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐// zhing khams kun tu sgron zhing gnas pa yi// snang gsal rnam mang ji snyed mchis pa kun// rin chen mkha' 'gro ma la 'bul lags na// rdo rje snang gsal ma yis mnyes gyur cig /oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī ā lo ke pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ zhing khams kun tu 'phro zhing gnas pa yi// dri mchog rnam mang ji snyed mchis pa kun// padma mkha' 'gro ma la 'bul lags na// rdo rje dri mchog ma yis mnyes gyur cig /oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī gandhe pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐// zhing khams kun tu sbyin dang gnas pa yi// ro mchog rnam mang ji snyed mchis pa kun// las kyi mkha' 'gro ma la 'bul lags na// rdo rje zhal zas ma yis mnyes gyur cig /oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī nai wi dye pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐// zhing khams kun tu grag cing gnas pa yi// sgra snyan rnam mang ji snyed mchis pa kun// chos dbyings mkha' 'gro ma la 'bul lags na/ /rdo rje sgra snyan ma yis mnyes gyur cig /oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī shapta pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐ phyag 'tshal bcom ldan dpa' bo dbang phyug ni// bskal pa'i me chen lta bur rab tu 'bar// ral pa'i cod pan dbu yi rgyan du bcings// mche ba rab gtsigs drag shul 'jigs pa'i zhal// sku la phyag stong gzi brjid ldan pa po// dgra sta zhags pa kha ṭwāṃ mdung bsnams shing*// rab 'jigs stag gi pags pa gos su gyon// sku chen dud kha bgegs mthar mdzad la 'dud// bcom ldan rnam kun rdo rje phag mo che// 'jig rten gsum gzhan rgol bas mi tshugs shing*// 'byung po'i 'jigs pa ma lus rdo rje phag mos 'gems// rdo rje gdan bzhugs tshangs pa las rgyal zhing*// bdud kyi sde rnams skems shing pham par mdzad// skye gnas 'byung ba kun gyi rang bzhin gzugs// sa gsum dbang phyug chos rnams yongs rdzogs mdzad// rnal 'byor 'dod pa'i dbang phyug ma la 'dud/

༈ snying ga'i sa bon las byung ba'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis dkyil 'khor pa la mchod par gyur/ yon chab mtha' yas bla na med pa 'di// rab 'byams chos kyi dbyings rnams bkang nas ni// dus gsum bla ma rnams dang dkon mchog mchod// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// oṃ shrī sarba ta thā ga ta badzra wā rā hī arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ rgyal ba'i sku la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang*// sems can nyon mongs bag chags sbyong slad du// sku gsung thugs la khrus chab 'di gsol bas// khams gsum gnas pa'i dri ma dag gyur cig /oṃ shrī sarba ta thā ga ta badzra wā rā hī pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ dkyil 'khor kun tu rgyal ba mnyes gyur pa'i// kha dog dbyibs legs rin chen me tog 'di// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis mngon sprul nas// gzhal yas khang du sprin bzhin gtib gyur cig /oṃ shrī sarba ta thā ga ta badzra wā rā hī puṣpaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ tshul khrims dri ldan spos mchog dam pa 'di// ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin rlabs pa'i// sangs rgyas zhing du spos dri ngad ldan pas// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams mnyes gyur cig /oṃ shrī sarba ta thā ga ta badzra wā rā hī dhū paṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ ye shes sgron me ma rig mun sel ba'i// shes rab gzi ldan dpal gyi sgron me ni// sprin med mkha' la nyi shar ji bzhin du// ye shes snang bas phyogs kun gsal gyur cig /oṃ shrī sarba ta thā ga ta badzra wā rā hī ā lo ke pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ stong gsum kun tu dri mchog 'byung gyur pa'i// spos dang sman sbyar chu gtsang rgyal ba'i chus// ye shes mkha' la bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis// mi gtsang dri ma'i tshogs rnams dag gyur cig /oṃ shrī sarba ta thā ga ta badzra wā rā hī gandhaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ rgyal ba'i sku la bkres pa mi mnga' yang*// 'gro ba'i don du lha rdzas bdud rtsi'i bshos// dag cing gtsang mar sbyar te 'bul lags na// ye shes thugs rje'i spyan gyis bzhes su gsol// oṃ shrī sarba ta thā ga ta badzra wā rā hī nai wi dyaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā/

dril chen sil snyan sgra sgrog tshangs pa'i dbyangs// rnga bo che dang dung sogs sgra snyan te// gsung dbyangs ngag gis bstod de gus 'bul na// sems can rnams la chos sgra sgrog par shog /oṃ shrī sarba ta thā ga ta badzra wā rā hī shapad pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ ༈ /bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// stong nyid snying rje ldan pa'i bdag nyid can// bskal pa'i me 'bar 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra sgrog /rdo rje gtum mo de la phyag 'tshal lo// phag gdong rtog med chos sku 'gyur med ston// khro mo'i thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma// 'gro don rdzogs mdzad 'jigs pa'i cha lugs can// rtog med 'gro don mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'jigs rung dpa' mo ma rungs tshar gcod ma// spyan gsum mche gtsigs sku gsum don dang ldan// nyon mongs gcod mdzad 'jigs pa'i nga ro can// bdud 'dul 'joms ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// skra grol gcer bu skyon bral 'jigs pa'i gzugs// nyon mongs skyon bral sems can don mdzad ma// thugs rje'i lcags kyus 'gro drug gnas nas 'dren// phrin las rdzogs mdzad de la phyag 'tshal bstod// dur khrod gnas bzhugs ru tra pho mo 'dul// drag mo 'jigs tshul phaṭ kyi sgra sgrog cing*// thabs mkhas thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma// bdud 'dul drag mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// chos nyid don rtogs 'ching ba'i tshul spangs ma// ro dang nyi zla padma'i gdan gyi tshul// rgyan rnams kun gyi rab mdzes khro mo'i sku// yon tan rdzogs mdzad de la phyag 'tshal bstod// gri gug thod pa kha ṭwāṃ phyag na bsnams// nyon mongs gcod mdzad ye shes 'od dang ldan// dug gsum gcod mdzad sku gsum lhun gyis grub// 'gro ba'i don mdzad de la phyag 'tshal bstod// bde chen rang byung rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mi 'gyur ye shes rdo rje chos kyi sku// rtog med spros bral ye shes chos dbyings don// yang dag gnyis med sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// lha mo drug gi rang bzhin rdo rje'i rigs// dpal 'bar 'jigs mdzad khro tshul 'gying bag can// bde chen rang byung phyag rgya chen po'i don// nyon mongs sgrol mdzad de la phyag 'tshal bstod// kun rdzob don dam rang bzhin phag mo ste// sku mdog dmar ba thugs rje'i rang 'od can// 'dod dgu phun tshogs rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// bde chen rang byung sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// dur khrod rgyan rnams sku la rdzogs pa ste// gri gug kha ṭwāṃ phyag mtshan so sor bsnams// thugs rje'i rang bzhin skra grol thur du spungs// spyan dmar 'dzum zhal de la phyag 'tshal bstod// phrin las drug pa rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// bde 'gro'i gnas su 'dren pa'i thugs rje can// skyon bral yang dag lha yi lhar gyur pa// rdo rje 'phrul mo che la phyag 'tshal bstod/

(mchod bzhi bstod bzhi dgos pa las/ mchod bzhi bstod gsum las mi 'dug bstod pa gnyis gcig tu 'dug pas dpyad par zhu*/) hūm̐ ri bo chen po'i lho phyogs na// u rgyan rang byung dur khrod nas// ri bo thams cad rus pa'i ri// rtsi shing thams cad mda' dang mdung*// chu klung thams cad khrag dang zhag /sa gzhi thams cad keng rus la// sgra skad thams cad hūm̐ dang phaṭ// khro bcu rgyu bar mi nus shing*// stobs chen thams cad 'joms pa'i sa// yum mchog rdo rje phag mo de na bzhugs// spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// phyag 'tshal mchod pa rab tu 'bul// ma yi sku mdog dmar ser 'od du 'bar ba las// bde chen nyams dang ldan pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// zhabs gnyis gar stabs skyil krung phyed pa las// bdud bzhi thal bar rlog pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// spyan gsum ldang mig phyogs bcur gzigs pa las// snang srid zil gyis gnon pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// zhal gnyis rab gdangs mche ba gtsigs pa las// skye 'chi rtsad nas gcod pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// don dam rang bzhin phag zhal nag po las// chos sku 'gyur ba med pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar ba las// bdud bzhi rtsad nas gcod pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// phyag g.yon bhandha khrag bkang bsnams pa las// rtog med zas la rol pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan pa las// rigs lngas 'gro don mdzad pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// dbu skra sil bu thur du grol ba las// sems can bde la 'god pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// rus pa'i rgyan drug sku la gsol ba las// pha rol phyin drug rdzogs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ nam mkhar phyar ba las// gnas lugs stong nyid rtogs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// de la mi mgo gsum gyis brgyan pa las// dug gsum gnad du bsnun pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// rdo rje 'khor los rab tu brgyan pa las// phrin las rnam bzhi mdzad pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// dar sna lnga yi ba dan phyar ba las// yon tan nub pa med pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// gser gyi bum pa rab tu ldir ba las// chos sku yon tan 'dzin pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// ḍā ma ru yi sil sgra 'khrol ba las// shes rab snyan brgyud 'dzin pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// yu ba drang zhing dkar la ldem pa las// bdud kyi rgyal mtshan bsnyel ba'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// rdo rje phyed pa thur du bstan pa las// dgra bgegs g.yul ngo zlog pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba las// gsang sngags rgyud sde 'dzin pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// yum gyi mkha' la mtho dman med pa las// chos rnams ma lus bzhugs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// ro yi gdan la dgyes par bzhugs pa las// rnam rtog thams cad spangs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// me dpung 'bar ba'i nang na bzhugs pa las// nyon mongs rnam rtog sreg pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// gcer bu sku mdog dpal gyi be'u las// 'dod chags bde bar bsgyur ba'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// 'di rnams thams cad ma yi sprul pa ste// khro mo'i gzugs can rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// dbang phyug gtso mo khyod la bdag bstod do// lha mo khyod la bstod pa'i bsod nams kyis// mi mthun gnod pa'i phyogs rnams zhi ba dang*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol/

༈ /snying kha'i sa bon las byung ba'i rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun gyis dkyil 'khor pa la mchod par gyur/ dzambu'i chu bo'i gser las legs byas shing*// rtsibs stong ldan pa'i dpag tshad lnga brgya pa// phyogs las rnam par rgyal bar byed pa yi// 'khor lo rin chen gus pas dbul bar bgyi// oṃ shrī badzra yo gi nī tsakra ratna pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ nam mkha'i mdzod ltar re ba skong mdzad cing*// nyi ma stong las lhag pa'i gzi brjid 'bar// dri med bai ḍūrya yi rin chen mchog /nor bu rin chen gus pas dbul bar bgyi// oṃ shrī badzra yo gi nī ma ṇi ratna pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ 'khri shing gzhon nu bzhin du lus phra zhing*// bzhin ras rgyas pa zla ba'i mdzes pa 'phrog /utpal mig can dga' bzhi mchog ster ma// btsun mo rin chen gus pas dbul bar bgyi// oṃ shrī badzra yo gi nī st+rī ratna pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ kun gyi gnas dang gter la rten byed cing*// rgol ba gzhan gyis brdzi bar mi nus shing*// tshogs gnyis rin chen gter la longs spyod pa// khyim bdag rin chen gus pas dbul bar bgyi// oṃ shrī badzra yo gi nī gṛ ha pa ti ratna pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ theg chen thal dkar mche ba drug ldan zhing*// dman pa'i 'jigs pa dag las rgyal byed kyi// sa la rab brtan lta bur bgrod gyur pa// glang po rin chen gus pas dbul bar bgyi// oṃ shrī badzra yo gi nī hasti ratna pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ sprin gyi shugs can cang shes kun gyi gtso// myur mgyogs rta bdun khengs pa 'phrog byed cing*// rdzu 'phrul mkha' la thogs med 'gro ba yi// rta mchog rin chen gus pas dbul bar bgyi// oṃ shrī badzra yo gi nī a shwa ratna pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ gang gi yid la 'dod pa'i dpal dag gis// rig shes gnas la mkhas pa'i dga' ston gyis// lhun grub 'bad pa med par spyod byed pa'i// blon po rin chen gus pas dbul bar bgyi// oṃ shrī badzra yo gi nī pa ri ṇā ya ka ratna pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/

hūm̐/ rdo rje phag mo bde gshegs yum// 'dod pa'i dbang phyug skal ldan ma// mkha' 'gro chen mo rnal 'byor gtso// rdo rje dbyings kyi khro rgyal yum// phyag rgya chen mo rdo rje'i sku// he ru ka dpal yang dag sbyor// dbu stong ma la spyan stong ma// stong phrag bcu yi zhal gdong ma// khro gnyer mche ba rab tu gtsigs// nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid can// spyan mig dmar ser glog ltar 'khyug /dbu skra gyen rdzes thog ser 'bebs// seng ge'i gzugs can 'dab bzang gzugs// glang po'i rgyal po'i che ba'i gzugs// 'jig rten gsum gyi lto ba can// rgya mtsho'i mtha' brtags ske rags can// thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin// rdo rje zangs gris gdug pa 'joms// mi rus phreng ba'i rgyan cha can// mi mgo rlon pa'i do shal can// bde gshegs 'bum ni khyod kyi 'khor// che ba'i lha rnams khyod kyi bran// rig pa'i rgyal mo 'dod gzugs can// rnal 'byor che ba'i dngos grub 'bebs// dpal chen dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i// hūm̐ dang phaṭ kyi 'brug sgra can// khro mo'i gzugs can khams gsum 'joms// rgya mtsho rdzing rnams skems par mdzad// sna tshogs pad nyi nges gnon cing*// srid pa gsum po za bar byed// zas su ma hā maṃ sa gsol// ma hā rakta btung bar byed// ma rungs gdug pa skrag mdzad cing*// rmongs dang rengs dang skrod mdzad ma// 'jigs par mdzad cing gsod par mdzad// ngo mtshar 'dod pa'i gzugs can ma// yid 'ong dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i// phag mo khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// bdag gis khyod la gang gsol ba'i// don de de ring stsal du gsol// dbang bzhi bskur bar mdzad du gsol// sku bzhi 'grub par mdzad du gsol// rgyud bzhi smin par byin gyis rlobs// phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub stsol// lte ba'i dbus gnas rnal 'byor ma// zhe sdang gcod mdzad grub pa mo// me long ye shes ngo bo nyid// rdo rje phag mo phyag 'tshal bstod// me dpung 'bar ba'i lte ba la// sku gsung thugs dang ye shes lnga// zag med bde ba ster mdzad ma// sangs rgyas yum la phyag 'tshal bstod// dhū ti'i 'od kyi rang bzhin la// dbugs bral lte ba nyid la bzhugs// zhu ba'i rang bzhin bde chen ma// bde ster yum la phyag 'tshal bstod// dngos po gshis kyi don ston ma// sku bzhi dbyer med gnyug ma'i ngang*// bde ba chen po'i ngo bo nyid// rdo rje mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod// bde chen lam sna 'dren pa'i yum// du ma ro gcig don ston ma// snang stong dbyer med ngo bo nyid// rin chen mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod// bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rab rgyal zhing*// bde chen byin gyis brlabs mdzad ma// rtsa rlung thig le'i ngo bo nyid// padma mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod// bdud dang log 'dren zhi mdzad ma// bar chad bsrung zhing byin rlabs can// mthu dang rdzu 'phrul ngo bo nyid// las kyi mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod// mchog dang thun mong la sogs pa'i// dbang bzhi bskur bar mdzad du gsol// sku bzhi 'grub par mdzad du gsol// rgyud bzhi smin par byin gyis rlobs// phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub stsol/

༈ snying kha'i sa bon las byung ba'i 'dod yon gyi lha mo dpag tu med pas dkyil 'khor pa la mchod par gyur/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan// phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis pa// mos blos rje btsun ma la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shing bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī rū pa kā ma gu ṇa badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i// yon tan yid 'ong sgra snyan ci mchis pa// mos blos rje btsun ma la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shing bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī shapta badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na tsandan sbrul snying dang*// a gar la sogs dbang po tshim byed dri// mos blos rje btsun ma la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shing bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī gandhe badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa'i// lus sems brtas byed ro mchog ci mchis pa// mos blos rje btsun ma la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shing bla med grub mchog bstsal du gsol// oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī ra sa badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na 'jam gnyen 'khril chags pa'i// reg bya'i khyad par 'phags pa ci mchis pa// mos blos rje btsun ma la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shing bla med grub mchog bstsal du gsol// oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī sparshe badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ srab 'jam yang pa lha yi gos// mi phyed rdo rje'i sku nyid la// mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na// bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī badzra wā sa sya pra tītstsha pu dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ sha chen gsur gyi bdug spos dang*// zhun chen gsal ba'i mar me dang*// byang sems dkar dmar bdud rtsi dang*// rdo rje dri chen zhal zas dang*// rdo rje dri chu'i bdud rtsi dang*// ḍā ma ru yi sil snyan gyis// pha rol phyin drug lha mo mchod// sa bcu non phyir bzhes su gsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐/
oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ ga na tsa kra kha raṃ khā hi/ oṃ badzra wā rā hī bai ro tsa nī ha ri ni sa kha raṃ khā hi/

('dir bstod pa dgos pa 'dra/) rang gi lte bar bam̐ la sngags bdun gyis bskor ba'i phyogs bzhir dga' ba 'khyil ba bzhi dmar po dag dang*/ steng du phag zhal nag po'i smin mtshams su dga' ba 'khyil ba dkar po gnas par gyur pa'i 'og gzhir/ sngags 'phreng rlung nang bcas pa sna bug nas thon/ 'gro ba rnams kyang de rnams su byas shing steng zhal gyi sna bug g.yas su zhugs/ g.yon pa nas thon rang gi sna bug g.yon par zhugs/ lte bar dga' 'khyil dang bcas pa 'khor bar dmigs te/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye badzra warṇa nī ye badzra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badzra ḍā ki nī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badzra lā me huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badzra khanḍa ro he huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badzra rū pi ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ de nas tshogs rdzas rnams mdun du tshogs par byas la byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kunḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ gis sbyangs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du ka pā la phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i nang du/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum bzlas nas/ hūm̐ 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas// bka' brgyud bla ma gshegs su gsol// nub phyogs u rgyan gzhal yas nas// rdo rje phag mo gshegs su gsol// bde chen dag pa'i gzhal yas nas// sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// mi 'gyur gnas pa'i gzhal yas nas// rdo rje mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// gter 'byung yid bzhin gzhal yas nas// rin chen mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// shes rab btsun mo'i gzhal yas nas// padma mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// dur khrod chen po'i gzhal yas nas// las kyi mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// 'jig rten sna tshogs kyi gzhal yas nas// sna tshogs mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// bsil ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod nas// chos skyong ma mgon gshegs su gsol// gnas khang 'di la byin gyis rlobs// tshogs gtor 'di la bcud cig phob// 'dir tshogs rnal 'byor thams cad la// rkyen ngan bar chad zhi ba dang*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol//

de nas chang la chos 'byung nyis brtsegs bris nas/ ngag tu/ dbus su oṃ baṃ las rdo rje phag mo dmar mo/ haṃ yoṃ las gshin rje ma sngon mo/ hrīṃ moṃ las rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ hriṃ hrīṃ las skyod byed ma ser mo/ huṃ hūm̐ las skrag byed ma ljang gu/ phaṭ phaṭ las tsaṇḍi ka dud kha rnams su gyur/ sor mo rnams su oṃ ha las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po/ na ma hi las rnam par snang mdzad ser po/ swā hā hu las padma gar gyi dbang phyug dmar po/ bau ṣaṭa he las he ru ka mthing ga huṃ hūm̐ hoḥlas rdo rje nyi ma dmar ser/ phaṭ haṃ las rta mchog ljang gu rnams su gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lag pa g.yon pa nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de dag gi mtha' skor du/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e āai/ o āau/ aṃ āḥ lag pa g.yas pa zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ ha hoḥhrīḥ de dag gi mtha' skor du/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzña nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa dha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha kṣa/ zla nyi yig 'bru dang bcas pa thod pa'i chang la thim/ rnam pa chang*/ ngo bo bdud rtsi/ rang bzhin lha zhu/ mtshan nyid bde stong*/ bde ba phun sum tshogs pa bskyed pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chang sna bzhi yi chang phud la// sa bcu non phyir lag mchod byas// shes rab g.yon gyi lag pa la// thabs chen g.yas kyi lag pas mchod// mtshan ldan rdo rje ka pā la// ka ni gang du mi gnas zhing*// pā ni ma skyes skye ba med// la ni blo 'das yid dang bral// sku gsum mi 'gyur ka pā lar// zag med bde ba'i chang phud gtams// skye 'chi med pa'i bdud rtsi blugs// yi ge gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs// oṃ gyis skye med sprul skur sbyangs// āḥyis 'gag med longs skur sgyur// hūm̐ gis blo 'das chos skur spel// lan gsum dkrugs pa'i bdud rtsi 'di// pha rol phyin drug lha mo mchod// mnyam nyid dbyings su bzhes su gsol/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mchod do phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyal sras tilli pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mkhas mchog nā ro pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mi la rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mnyam med sgam po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bde gshegs phag mo gru pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos kyi rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ slar yang rdo rje 'chang gi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yi dam rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lakṣiṃ ka ra'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dpal ldan birwa pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ a ba dhū ti pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ grub chen sha ba ri pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dpal ldan ldom bu pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bla ma sangs rgyas sbyin gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sngags 'chang haṃ ka ra'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bla ma kun dga' badzra gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bla ma skyi ston chen po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bla ma dar ma bsod nams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bla ma grags pa chen po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bla ma ri khrod dbang phyug gi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ thugs sras chos rje'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bla ma legs pa mgon po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bla ma badzra bkra shis kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bla ma byang chub bzang po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mnyam med ngag dbang grags pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mang thos dkon mchog ratna'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

rtsa ba'i bla ma kun dga' ratna'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'di man kha skong*/ mnyam med rin chen phun tshogs kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rje btsun chos rgyal phun tshogs kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mkhan chen rnam 'joms phun tshogs kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rnam 'dren dkon mchog phrin las rnam rgyal kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dkon mchog phrin las bzang po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sku bzhi'i dbang phyug dharma rā dza'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rigs brgya'i khyab bdag dkon mchog bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dpal ldan mgar chen pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rje btsun chos kyi nyi ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ khyab bdag padma'i rgyal mtshan gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mtshungs med chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ khri chen ma hā mañdzu'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang byung chos nyid nor bu'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rje btsun thugs rje nyi ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ o rgyan nus ldan rdo rje'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rje btsun dkon mchog chos skyabs kyi oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'dren mchog chos kyi blo gros kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ kun gzigs zhi ba'i blo gros kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang dbang bskur rgyud bshad man ngag gzhung 'grel thob pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa brgyud pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye badzra warṇa nī ye badzra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra ḍā ki nī oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra lā me oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra khanḍa ro he oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra rū pi ṇī ye oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang zung du 'brel ba'i yi dam rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

dam pa ye shes chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lag mchod ni/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kunḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ gis sbyangs/ rang gi lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du g.yas pa'i srin lag gis nang mchod la reg pas 'byung nyis brtsegs bris la/ dbus su oṃ baṃ las rdo rje phag mo dmar mo/ haṃ yoṃ las gshin rje ma sngon mo/ hrīṃ moṃ las rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ hriṃ hrīṃ las skyod byed ma ser mo/ huṃ hūm̐ las skrag byed ma ljang gu/ phaṭ phaṭ las tsaṇḍi ka dud kha rnams su gyur/ mthe bong nas brtsams te/ oṃ ha las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po/ na ma hi las rnam par snang mdzad ser po/ swā hā hu las padma gar gyi dbang phyug dmar po/ bau ṣaṭa he las he ru ka mthing ga /huṃ hūm̐ hoḥlas rdo rje nyi ma dmar ser/ phaṭ haṃ las rta mchog ljang gu rnams su gyur/ thabs g.yas bskor dang*/ shes rab g.yon skor du oṃ gsum ma sogs kyi mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis 'bul / yon chab mtha' yas bla na med pa 'di// rab 'byams chos kyi dbyings rnams bkang nas ni// dus gsum bla ma rnams dang dkon mchog mchod// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// oṃ shrī sarba ta thā ga ta badzra wā rā hī arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ rgyal ba'i sku la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang*// sems can nyon mongs bag chags sbyangs slad du// sku gsung thugs la khrus chab 'di gsol bas// khams gsum gnas pa'i dri ma dag gyur cig /oṃ shrī sarba ta thā ga ta badzra wā rā hī pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ dkyil 'khor kun tu rgyal ba mnyes gyur pa'i// kha dog dbyibs legs rin chen me tog 'di// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis mngon sprul nas// gzhal yas khang du sprin bzhin gtib gyur cig /oṃ shrī sarba ta thā ga ta badzra wā rā hī puṣpaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā/

tshul khrims dri ldan spos mchog dam pa 'di// ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin rlabs pa'i// sangs rgyas zhing du spos dri ngad ldan pas// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams mnyes gyur cig /oṃ shrī sarba ta thā ga ta badzra wā rā hī dhū paṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ ye shes sgron me ma rig mun sel ba'i// shes rab gzi ldan dpal gyi sgron me ni// sprin med mkha' la nyi shar ji bzhin du// ye shes snang bas phyogs kun gsal gyur cig /oṃ shrī sarba ta thā ga ta badzra wā rā hī ā lo kaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ stong gsum kun tu dri mchog 'byung gyur pa'i// spos dang sman sbyar chu gtsang rgyal ba'i chus// ye shes mkha' la bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis// mi gtsang dri ma'i tshogs rnams dag gyur cig /oṃ shrī sarba ta thā ga ta badzra wā rā hī gandhaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ rgyal ba'i sku la bkres pa mi mnga' yang*// 'gro ba'i don du lha rdzas bdud rtsi'i bshos// dag cing gtsang mar sbyar te 'bul lags na// ye shes thugs rje'i spyan gyis bzhes su gsol// oṃ shrī sarba ta thā ga ta badzra wā rā hī nai wi dyaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ dril chen sil snyan sgra sgrog tshangs pa'i dbyangs// rnga bo che dang dung sogs sgra snyan te// gsung dbyangs ngag gis bstod de gus 'bul na// sems can rnams la chos sgra sgrog par shog /oṃ shrī sarba ta thā ga ta badzra wā rā hī shapad pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ hūm̐/ nub phyogs u rgyan gzhal yas nas// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// dkyil krung phyed pa ro yi gdan// gcer bu skra grol sku mdog dmar// g.yas pa rtog med phag gdong zhal// g.yon pa khro zhal spyan gsum ldan// nyon mongs gcod mdzad gri gug g.yas// thod pa dang ni kha ṭwāṃ g.yon// mi mgo rlon pa'i do shal can// mi rus phreng ba'i rgyan dang ldan// zhing chen rus rgyan sku la gsol// khyod ni stong nyid snying rje'i bdag

/rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// oṃ baṃ las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro ma// dmar mo gri gug thod khrag 'dzin// rab 'jigs bde gshegs dgyes mdzad ma// rdo rje phag mo phyag 'tshal bstod/ haṃ yoṃ las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro ma/ sngon mo gri gug thod khrag 'dzin// sgeg mo stabs kyis gar nyams mdzad// gshin rje ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// hriṃ moṃ las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro ma// dkar mo gri gug thod khrag 'dzin// rab mdzes rdzu 'phrul stobs 'chang ma// rmongs byed ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// hriṃ hriṃ las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro ma// ser mo gri gug thod khrag 'dzin// sdig pa 'joms mdzad 'od zer 'bar// skyod byed ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// huṃ hūm̐ las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro ma// ljang mo gri gug thod khrag 'dzin// dpa' mo'i mtshan can drag shul can// skrag byed ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// phaṭ phaṭ las skyes pa'i mkha' gro ma// nag mo gri gug thod khrag 'dzin// rab 'jigs khro mo'i cha lugs can// tsaṇḍi ka la phyag 'tshal bstod// oṃ ha sa bon dkar po las// zhal gsum phyag drug mdzes pa'i sku// spyan gsum mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnams// rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal bstod// na ma hi ni ser po las// dpa' bar ral pa'i thor gtsug can// ya mtshan dar dang rus pas brgyan// rnam par snang mdzad phyag 'tshal bstod// swa hā hūm̐ las byung ba yi// padma rā ga'i mdog ltar dmar// spyan gsum mche gtsigs gdug pa 'dul// padma gar dbang phyag 'tshal bstod// bau ṣaṭa he ni mthing ka las// g.yas rkyang nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs// phyag rgya drug gis rab tu brgyan// he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod// huṃ hūm̐ ho ni dpa' bo'i gzugs// thabs mchog sgeg pa'i gar nyams can// 'khor lo nor bu'i do shal mdzes// rin chen nyi ma phyag 'tshal bstod// phaṭ phaṭ haṃ las byung ba yis// ljang khu phrin las sgrub mdzad cing*// gri thod ral gri ḍā ma ru// rab bsnams dpa' bo phyag 'tshal bstod// kyai bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rnams dang*/

sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang*/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lha tshogs rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag rnal 'byor pa 'dir 'tshogs shing 'khod pa rnams kyi rgyud la/ de bzhin nyid kyi ye shes nam mkha' lta bu dang*/ rgya mtsho lta bu dang*/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po dbang gi rgyal po lta bus gang bar mdzad du gsol/ yongs su gang bar mdzad gsol/ shin tu gang bar mdzad du gsol/ rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ yongs su rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ shin tu rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ smin par mdzad du gsol/ yongs su smin par mdzad du gsol/ shin tu smin par mdzad du gsol/

zhes lan gsum brjod/ na mo dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs/ lhun grub rgyun chad med pa'i yon tan gyi gter du gyur pas/ bdag sogs nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum rnam par dag cing*/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs mnyam pa nyid lhun grub rgyun chad med par mdzad du gsol/ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par bsam/ thal mo gnas gsum gtug la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ/ 'bras rgun bu ram bcos pa'i chang*// shes rab ma dā nang gi mchod pa 'di// dbang bzhi bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// longs spyad pas dbang bzhi'i don rtogs shog /ba la sha lnga 'bras 'khur dang*// thabs gti mug maṃ sa'i mchod pa 'di// rtog med bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// longs spyad pas chos sku thob par shog /thig le rkang dang khu ba zhag /tshogs dang rakta'i mchod pa 'di// bde stong bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// longs spyad pas longs sku thob par shog /dbang po lnga yi mchod pa dang*// sna tshogs keng rus mchod pa 'di// gsal stong bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// longs spyad pas sprul sku thob par shog /snying zho sha la sogs dam tshig rdzas// pañtsa a mṛ ta yi mchod pa 'di// dam tshig bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// longs spyad pas bslab gsum don rtogs shog /bu ram la sogs mngar gsum dang*// dkar gsum arghaṃ mchod pa 'di// zag med bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// longs spyad pas skye med don rtogs shog /dri zhim sman gyi mchod pa dang*// gzugs sdug 'dod yon sgra snyan sogs// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'di// rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba yi// rigs lnga'i bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// longs spyad pas 'khor 'das ma lus kyi// yon tan rin chen thob gyur cig /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ brjod pa oṃ gyi 'od zer gyis// zhe sdang las gyur tshogs kyi rdzas// dkar la mdangs chags bdud rtsir gyur// sku bde ba chen por 'gyur ba'i rdzas// longs spyad pas rin chen chos sku la// nyams rtogs dbyer med 'phel gyur cig

/gnod sems zhe sdang 'khrug pa kun// byams pa chen por 'gyur bar shog oṃ āḥhūm̐/ brjod pa āḥyi 'od zer gyis// 'dod chags las gyur tshogs kyi rdzas// dmar la mdangs chags bdud rtsir gyur// 'gag med gsung sgra sgrog pa'i rdzas// longs spyad pas gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu yis// gdul bya ma lus tshim gyur cig /zag bcas nyon mongs 'dod chags kun// zag med bde bar 'gyur bar shog oṃ āḥhūm̐// brjod pa hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis// gti mug las gyur tshogs kyi rdzas// mthing la mdangs chags bdud rtsir gyur// thugs mnyam nyid chos skur 'gyur ba'i rdzas// longs spyad pas sems rgyud ye shes lnga// rgyun chad med par 'brel gyur cig /rmongs shing ma rig gti mug sogs// 'od gsal chen por 'gyur bar shog /mkhyen pa'i ye shes lnga ldan pa'i// rtog bral bdud rtsi'i tshogs 'khor 'di// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas// lnga rdzogs bdud rtsi yin pa'i phyir// bde gshegs rdo rje 'chang la sogs// dus gsum bde gshegs dpa' bo dang*// phyi nang mkha' 'gros bzhes su gsol// a la la ste dgyes par mdzod/ hūm̐ rnal 'byor dbang phyug dpa' bo dang*// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas rnams kyis// bdag cag 'dir 'tshogs rnal 'byor gyi// phung po khams dang skye mched dang*// lus ngag yid gsum thams cad dang*// ye shes chen po lnga ldan pa'i// bde gshegs rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// lus sprul sku sangs rgyas su byin gyis rlobs// ngag longs spyod rdzogs skur byin gyis rlobs// sems gnyis med chos skur byin gyis rlobs// sku gsum ma thob bar du ni// phyi nang bar chad mi 'byung zhing*// 'du ba rnam bzhi'i nad rnams sol// mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad zlog /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// zhes tshogs rnams gtubs la tshogs phud dang nang mchod gtor ma la bran/

rol mo dang bcas te ngag tu 'di skad brjod/ hūm̐ gzugs sgra dri ro reg la sogs// dgyes pa mchog gi mchod pa 'di// dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma la// brgyud pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang*// bcom ldan 'khor lo sdom pa la// dpa' bo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang*// yum chen rdo rje phag mo la// dpa' mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba la// tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen 'di// gnyis med ngang du 'bul lags na// blang dor med par bzhes su gsol// a la la ste dgyes par rol// a la la ste dgyes par mdzod/ hūm̐/ bcom ldan buddha he ru kaḥ /dpa' bo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang*// yum chen sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro la// dpa' mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang*// tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen 'di// gnyis med ngang du 'bul lags na// blang dor med par bzhes su gsol// a la la ste dgyes par rol// a la la ste dgyes par mdzod/ / hūm̐ bcom ldan badzra he ru kaḥ /dpa' bo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang*// yum chen rdo rje mkha' 'gro la// dpa' mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang*// tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen 'di// gnyis med ngang du 'bul lags na// blang dor med par bzhes su gsol// a la la ste dgyes par rol// a la la ste dgyes par mdzod/ hūm̐ bcom ldan ratna he ru kaḥ /dpa' bo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang*/ /yum chen rin chen mkha' 'gro la// dpa' mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang*// tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen 'di// gnyis med ngang du 'bul lags na/ /blang dor med par bzhes su gsol// a la la ste dgyes par rol// a la la ste dgyes par mdzod/ hūm̐ bcom ldan padma he ru kaḥ /dpa' bo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang*// yum chen padma mkha' 'gro la// dpa' mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang*// tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen 'di// gnyis med ngang du 'bul lags na// blang dor med par bzhes su gsol// a la la ste dgyes par rol// a la la ste dgyes par mdzod/

hūm̐ bcom ldan karma he ru kaḥ /dpa' bo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang*// yum chen las kyi mkha' 'gro la// dpa' mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang*// tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen 'di// gnyis med ngang du 'bul lags na// blang dor med par bzhes su gsol// a la la ste dgyes par rol// a la la ste dgyes par mdzod/ hūm̐ dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal// 'jigs su rung ba bskal pa'i me// dmar nag 'khrug pa'i klong dkyil na// dpal ldan ma hā kā la dang*// yum chen tsaṇṭi dbang phyug ma// 'khor nag po stong dang sha za 'bum// ma mo bye ba'i 'khor dang bcas// ma lus 'khor tshogs thams cad la// tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen 'di// gnyis med ngang du 'bul lags na// blang dor med par bzhes su gsol// a la la ste dgyes par rol// a la la ste dgyes par mdzod/ hūm̐ pho brang mkha' spyod tsā ri nas// bdud mgon seng gdong yab yum la// 'khor nag po stong dang sha za 'bum// ma mo bye ba'i tshogs dang bcas// ma lus 'khor tshogs thams cad la// tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen 'di// gnyis med ngang du 'bul lags na// blang dor med par bzhes su gsol// a la la ste dgyes par rol// a la la ste dgyes par mdzod/ hūm̐ 'bri gung dpal gyi nags khrod nas// a phyi chos kyi sgrol ma la// mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum gyis bskor// ma lus 'khor tshogs thams cad la// tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen 'di// gnyis med ngang du 'bul lags na// blang dor med par bzhes su gsol// a la la ste dgyes par rol/ a la la ste dgyes par mdzod// de nas gtor ma rgyas par 'bul ba ni/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kunḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ kaṃ las mi mgo gsum gyi sgyed pu'i steng du/

āḥlas byung ba'i thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba/ dpral ba rang la bstan pa de'i nang du/ go ku da ha na las sha lnga/ bi mū ra shu ma las bdud rtsi lnga/ bhrāṃ aṃ dzrīṃ khaṃ hūm̐ las ye shes lnga/ de'i steng du zla ba la gnas pa'i kha ṭwāṃ ga rtse thur la bstan pa/ de'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yig 'bru gsum po de las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros/ rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol te/ kha ṭwāṃ ga las bdud rtsi'i rgyun dpag tu med pa bab/ slar yang 'od zer rlangs pa dang bcas pa phyogs bcur 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka dang*/ sbyor mtshams nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ yi ge gsum kha ṭwāṃ ga dang bcas pa dam tshig gi bdud rtsi la thim pas zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi kha dog dri ro reg bya nus pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ/ lan gsum brjod/ de nas 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral ba'i dbyings su skor zhing*/ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ gtor 'gron phyogs bcu 'jig rten gyi khams su bzhugs pa'i ye shes pa dang*/ las dang 'jig rten pa las skyes pa'i dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro zhing skyong dang*/ rje btsun ma'i lha tshogs spyan drangs/ ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gsol bar gyur/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmaḥnaṃ ādya nutpanna twatta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ/ oṃ badzra ā ralli hoḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ dṛ shya hoḥ gu ru ratna buddha dharmaḥbo dhi sa twa i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi// rdo rje 'chang chen po i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rgyal sras tilli pa i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mkhas mchog nā ro pa i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mar pa chos kyi blo gros i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mi la rdo rje rgyal mtshan i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/

mnyam med sgam po pa i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bde gshegs phag mo gru pa i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ chos rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ slar yang rdo rje 'chang i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ yi dam rdo rje rnal 'byor ma i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lakṣiṃ ka ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ dpal ldan birwa pa i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ a ba dhū ti pa i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ grub chen sha ba ri i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ dpal ldan ldom bu pa i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bla ma sangs rgyas sbyin i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sngags 'chang haṃ ka ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bla ma kun dga' badzra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bla ma skyi ston chen po i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bla ma lha rje ston pa i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bla ma dar ma bsod nams i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bla ma grags pa chen po i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bla ma ri khrod dbang phyug i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ thugs sras chen po i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bla ma legs pa mgon po i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bla ma badzra bkra shis i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bla ma byang chub bzang po i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mnyam med ngag dbang grags i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mang thos dkon mchog ratna i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rgyal dbang kun dga' ratna i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ 'di man kha skong*/ mnyam med rin chen phun tshogs i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rje btsun chos rgyal phun tshogs i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mkhan chen rnam 'joms phun tshogs i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/

rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rnam 'dren dkon mchog phrin las rnam rgyal i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ dkon mchog phrin las bzang po i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sku bzhi'i dbang phyug dharma rā dza i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rigs brgya'i khyab bdag dkon mchog bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ dpal ldan mgar chen pa i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rje btsun chos kyi nyi ma i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ khyab bdag padma'i rgyal mtshan i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mtshungs med chos kyi rgyal mtshan i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ khri chen ma hā mañdzu i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rang byung chos nyid nor bu i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rje btsun chos kyi nyi ma i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ khyab bdag padma'i rgyal mtshan i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ o rgyan nus ldan rdo rje i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rje btsun dkon mchog chos skyabs i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ 'dren mchog chos kyi blo gros i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ kun gzigs zhi ba'i blo gros i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi// 'di yan kha skong yin/ de rjes ngag tu/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī badzra warṇa nī ye badzra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ ma hā kā lā hūm̐ phaṭ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye nas ngag tu/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yakṣa/ rākṣa sa/ bhū ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsā/ unmā da/ a pa sma ra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya dā ya i maṃ ba liṃ gṛhṇantu/ sa ma ya rakṣantu/

ma ma sarba siddhi mme pra yatstshantu/ ya the baṃ/ ya thaiṣṭaṃ/ bhuñdza tha/ pi ba tha/ dzi ghra tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kārta ya sat+su khaṃ bi shuddha ya sa hā yi kaṃ bha wantu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ i daṃ daṃ bā liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ las kyi mkha' 'gro ma la dmigs nas 'bul ba ni/ oṃ heṃ haṃ haṃ/ he he/ ha ha/ ho ho/ pheṃ pheṃ/ phaṭ phaṭ/ i daṃ ba li ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rang rang so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ badzra wā rā hī arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ oṃ badzra wā rā hī pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ oṃ badzra wā rā hī puṣpaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ oṃ badzra wā rā hī dhū paṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ oṃ badzra wā rā hī ā lo ke pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ oṃ badzra wā rā hī gandhaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ oṃ badzra wā rā hī nai we dyaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ oṃ badzra wā rā hī shapad pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ zhing skyong chen po brgyad rnams dang*// mkha' 'gro sum cu so gnyis dang*// lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// klu yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// 'byung po'i tsheogs rnams ma lus dang*// yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// sha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// smyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// brjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// ma lus pa ni thams cad dag /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun 'grub cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyi stongs grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// byad stems ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*// bde legs phun sum tshogs pa yi// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog

ces dang*/ yi ge brgya pa bzlas/ de nas tshogs rdo rje slob dpon la drangs nas/ kyai rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag gi tshogs kyi yo byad 'di// dang ba'i yid kyis 'bul lags na// ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol// zhes drangs/ slob dpon gyis/ hūm̐ bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi sku// 'dod chags dri ma dang bral bas// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs// de kho nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal// zhes pad skor dang bcas g.yas pas blangs/ g.yon pas longs spyad/ slob ma rnams la drangs nas ngag tu/ gzigs shig mdzes ldan dam pa'i chos// 'di la the tshom byar mi rung*// bram ze khyi dang gdol pa gsum// rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs te rol// zhes gtod/ bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi sku// 'dod chags dri ma dang bral bas// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs// de kho nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal// brjod la blangs/ tshogs lhag pham lhag bsdus nas/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi phyag rgya bkab cing*/ nang mchod kha spris btab nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmaḥnaṃ ādya nutpanna twatta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ lan gsum byin gyis brlabs nas/ hūm̐ rdo rje phag mo'i lhag ma'i bdag /sngags las skyes dang zhing las skyes// las las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro ma// 'dir gshegs lhag ma'i gtor ma bzhes// dpal gyi pha 'bab 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi// rkyen ngan bar chad zhi ba dang*// phrin las rnam bzhi grub par mdzod/ hūm̐ gzhan yang tshogs kyi lhag ma'i bdag /dur khrod brgyad kyi gnas nyul zhing*// lhag ma bsdud pa'i mkha' 'gro ma// 'dir gshegs lhag ma'i gtor ma bzhes// dpal gyi pha 'bab 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi// rkyen ngan bar chad zhi ba dang*// phrin las rnam bzhi grub par mdzod/ hūm̐ gzhan yang tshogs kyi lhag ma'i bdag /lha klu gnod sbyin sde brgyad rnams// 'dir gshegs lhag ma'i gtor ma bzhes// dpal gyi pha 'bab 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi// rkyen ngan bar chad zhi ba dang*// phrin las rnam bzhi grub par mdzod/

hūm̐ gzhan yang tshogs kyi lhag ma'i bdag /yul phyogs 'dir gnas 'byung po rnams// 'dir gshegs lhag ma'i gtor ma bzhes// dpal gyi pha 'bab 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi// rkyen ngan bar chad zhi ba dang*// phrin las rnam bzhi grub par mdzod/ hūm̐ gzhan yang tshogs kyi lhag ma'i bdag /lhag mar dbang zhing gang lhags pa// 'dir gshegs lhag ma'i gtor ma bzhes/ dpal gyi pha 'bab 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi// rkyen ngan bar chad zhi ba dang*// phrin las rnam bzhi grub par mdzod// oṃ utstshiṣṭa ba lingta bhakṣa bhakṣa ka swā hā/ /skabs 'dir bdag 'jug dang slob ma rjes su 'jug pa'i bya ba la/ bdag 'jug rang len pa'i skabs su maṇḍal phul nas/ dpal ldan sa ra ha pa yi// zhes pa nas gsol gdab dang*/ skyabs 'gro/ sdom bzung byas nas/ dam bzhag sogs mi dgos/ slob ma rjes su bzung dus sdom las byung ba ltar bgyid pa'o// sdom las/ bgegs bskrad srung 'khor maṇḍal dang*// gsol gdab skyabs sems sdom bzung dang*// dam bzhag dam bsgrags khyor chu blud// gdong g.yogs me tog lag tu gtad// ces pas/ de la dang po/ bgegs gtor bshams nas ngag tu/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kunḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ kyis bsangs/ oṃ swā bhā wa shuddha sarba dharmā swā bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ gis sbyangs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las a las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ ā kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ā dyanutpanna twatta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ zhes lan gsum dang*/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo/ de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs mdzes dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'byams klas la phyag 'tshal lo/

de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa thams cad yongs su bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta dzñā na a wa lo ki te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūm̐/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di 'bul zhing bsngo ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni bgegs kyi rgyal po bi nā ya kas gtso byas pa'i bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu/ byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga/ mdor na rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa thams cad dang*/ 'byung po'i rigs thams cad la sbyin no// dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba ma grub bar du/ 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig ces rol mo dang bcas te/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta la sogs drag sngags brjod/ sarba bhū ta gatstsha/ zhes brjod/ gu gul dang thun bsregs la ngag tu/ na mo/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ rig sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ gzungs sngags kyi rgyal mo khro mo rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos dbyings de bzhin nyid kyi bden pa'i mthu la brten nas/ rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gdon bgegs kyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'dis tshim par gyis la/ gnod pa dang gdug pa'i bsam sbyor ngan pa mtha' dag zhi nas/ phan pa bde ba byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyur cig bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dag dang*// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang*// chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyi// don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun// de dag thams cad ci rigs pa// thogs pa med par 'byung 'gyur cig /rang dang slob ma thams cad kyi 'og tu rdo rje'i sa gzhi/

bar du ra ba/ steng du gur dang bla re/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo brtan par gyur/ maṇḍal gzhung bzhin phul nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ /dpal ldan sa ra ha pa yis// sha ba ri la dbang bskur ltar// de bzhin bla ma khyod kyis ni// bdag la dbang bskur mdzad du gsol// lan gsum dang*/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming kyai dpal 'di zhes bgyi ba la/ de bzhin nyid kyi ye shes/ nam mkha' lta bu dang*/ rgya mtsho lta bu dang*/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dbang gi chu bo lta bus gang bar mdzad du gsol/ yongs su gang bar mdzad du gsol/ shin tu gang bar mdzad du gsol/ rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ yongs su rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ shin tu rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ smin par mdzad du gsol/ yongs su smin par mdzad du gsol/ shin tu smin par mdzad du gsol/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni bzhugs par gsol// zhes lan gsum dang*/ skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyid nas// sems can thams cad bdag gi 'gron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog

/ lan gsum dang*/ sdom bzung ni/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ming kyai dpal 'di zhes bgyi ba yis// dus ni 'di nas bzung ste ni// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa dag gis bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni bsdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// deng nas brtsams te mi spang ngo*// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i// sdom pa deng nas brtan por bzung*// rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid tu bzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po las// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// padma'i rigs chen dag pa las// phyi dang nang dang gsang ba gsum// dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung*// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyid nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*// ma brgal ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin rnams dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// rdo rje mgor bzhag nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ deng khyod rdo rje rnal 'byor mas byin gyis rlabs kyi/
