mkha' 'gro ma kun gyi dbang bskur zhing gsang ba 'di/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar mi bya zhing*/ ma dad pa rnams la mchog tu gsang bar bya yi/ slar yang deng nas brtsams te khyod kyi rdo rje slob dpon nga yin gyi/ nga yis ji ltar bsgo ba bzhin du bya dgos so// gal te khyod kyis nga la brnyas par byed na/ mi bde ba ma spangs par tshe'i dus byas nas dmyal bar lhung bar 'gyur ta re/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig nyams na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu yis 'grub// oṃ badzra u da ka ṭha ṭha ṭhaḥ mig dar dmar po dang me tog gtad la/ oṃ tsakṣurbahandha wa ra mā na ya hūm̐/ oṃ a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐/ las kyi rdo rjes yol ba'i nang du khrid la/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal du bcug la/ hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐/ na maḥte hūm̐/ na maḥmi hūm̐/ na mo na māḥhūm̐/ bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos// de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te// kun gyi byed po bla ma yin// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los bsgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsung thugs// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma la bzhugs pa'i// mkha' 'gro ma dang lā ma dang*// dum skyes ma dang gzugs can ma// mkha' 'gro chen mo bzhi la 'dud/ /mig dar bsal nas/ rnal 'byor ma dpal deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par bgyi// phye bas thams cad mthong bar 'gyur// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// oṃ badzra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed// khyod ni rnal 'byor ma'i rigs skyes// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis rlobs// 'gro ba phun sum tshogs kun dang*// grub kun khyod la mngon du 'gyur// dam tshig thams cad skyong ba dang*// sngags kyi dngos grub brtson par gyis//

de nas me tog dkyil 'khor la dor nas/ pra tītstsha badzra hoḥ zhes phul/ slar yang gtso mos gnang bar mos la/ mgo bor bzhag la/ sems can stobs chen khyod kyis ni// 'di ni rab tu gzung bar gyis// dad dang bsam dang mos pa yi// rnal 'byor dag la brtson par gyis// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha ngo bstan pa ni/ chos kyi 'byung gnas nyis brtsegs/ srung 'khor rdo ra dur khrod me ri dang bcas pa mngon sum du mthong ba'i mos pa mdzod/ phyogs bzhi mkha' 'gro ma bzhi phyag mtshan ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba/ gtso mo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang*/ mtshams bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa dang bcas shing*/ jo mo lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor brten dang rten par bcas pa mngon sum du mthong ba'i mos pa mdzod/ dngos gzhi dbang gi sdom la/ ye shes dbab dang bum dbang rig dbang dang*// gsang ba shes rab ye shes dbang dag dang*// mchog dbang rdo rje slob dpon dbang rnams byin// zhes so// ye shes dbab pa'i don du gsol ba gdab pa ni/ kye bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming kye dpal 'di zhes bgyi ba la/ de bzhin nyid kyi ye shes nam mkha' lta bu dang*/ rgya mtsho lta bu dang*/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po lta bu gang bar mdzad du gsol/ yongs su gang bar mdzad du gsol/ shin tu gang bar mdzad du gsol/ rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ yongs su rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ shin tu rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ smin par mdzad du gsol/ yongs su smin par mdzad du gsol/ shin tu smin par mdzad du gsol/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la// mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar// bdag kyang skyob pa'i don gyi phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol// zhes pas gsol ba btab nas slob ma rdo rje rnal 'byor mar bsgom/ bdud rtsi byugs pa'i maṇḍal slob ma'i grangs dang mnyam par bkod de dbus su rkang pa gnyis gshibs nas langs te/

lag pa gnyis rdo rje bsdams pa'i phyag rgya las/ gung mo bsgrengs pa'i bar du me tog bzung ste spyi bor bzhag nas/ rlung steng 'og kha sbyar te/ bla ma'i dmigs pa phog ltar bsgom/ skad cig gis khyed rang rnams rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i smin mtshams su sindhu ra'i g.yung drung 'khyil ba g.yon du 'khor ba dang*/ phag zhal nag po'i smin mtshams su dga' ba 'khyil ba dkar po 'khor ba/ mdun du bla ma dang rje btsun mar dbyer med pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa byung bas/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ lte bar phag mo gar mdzad pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin rlabs rang la thim/ rang la bde stong gi ye shes rgyud la skyes par bsam/ rol mo byas la bla mas ngag tu/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye badzra warṇa nā ye badzra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ a we sha ya ā ā/ hriṃ hriṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ pheṃ pheṃ/ phaṭ phaṭ/

ces brjod/ me tog rdo rje mgo bor bzhag la/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ tiṣṭha badzra/ brtan par byas nas/ bum pa'i dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ kye bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming kye dpal 'di zhes bgyi ba la/ de bzhin nyid kyi ye shes nam mkha' lta bu dang*/ rgya mtsho lta bu dang*/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po lta bu gang bar mdzad du gsol/ yongs su gang bar mdzad du gsol/ shin tu gang bar mdzad du gsol/ rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ yongs su rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ shin tu rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ smin par mdzad du gsol/ yongs su smin par mdzad du gsol/ shin tu smin par mdzad du gsol/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la// mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar// bdag kyang skyob pa'i don gyi phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ ༈ /slob dpon gyi lte ba'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi phyag na/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin bdud rtsi dang byang sems kyis gang ba'i bum pa dang thod pa bzung ba rnams spyan drangs/ bum pa la thim/ badzra sa ma dzāḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bum pa spyi bor bzhag nas/ /dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ khams gsum kun gyi phyag byas pas// gsang gsum gnas nas byung ba 'di// sangs rgyas kun gyis sbyin par bya/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye badzra warṇa nā ye badzra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ a bhi ṣ-iñtsa hūm̐/ sangs rgyas kun gyi bum pa'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir// bum pa'i dbang ni khyod la bskur// ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyi ni// lha rnams kun gyis khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yi// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/

bum pa'i chus dbang bskur dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rigs lngas dbu brgyan par gyur/ rdo rje lag tu gtad la/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro zhe sdang rnam dag pa// rnam shes gnas gyur me long ye shes kyi// rang bzhin mi g.yo mchog gi dbang bskur bas// bde gshegs kun gyi thugs su grol gyur cig /oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ dbang gi lha rnams slob ma'i lus la zhugs/ bum chus gtor zhing bkrus la blugs/ dri ma'i phung po nyon mongs dag /sku dang ye shes dbang rnams thob/ mgo bor chu las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ ༈ /slob dpon gyi lte ba'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi phyag na/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin dbu brgyan dang dar dpyangs gzung ba rnams spyan drangs/ dbu rgyan dang dar dpyangs la thim/ badzra sa ma dzāḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sangs rgyas kun gyi dbu rgyan dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir// dbu rgyan dbang ni bskur bar bgyi// ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kun gyis khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yi// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐// rin po che lag tu gtad cing*/ rin chen mkha' 'gro nga rgyal rnam dag pa// tshor ba gnas gyur mnyam nyid ye shes kyi// rang bzhin mi g.yo mchog gi dbang bskur bas// bde gshegs kun gyi yon tan rdzogs gyur cig oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ dbang gi lha rnams slob ma'i lus la zhugs/ bum chus gtor zhing bkrus la blugs/ dri ma'i phung po nyon mongs dag sku dang ye shes dbang rnams thob/ mgo bor chu las rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dbu brgyan par gyur/

slob dpon gyi lte ba'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi phyag na/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin rtse mo dgu pa'i rdo rje bzung ba rnams spyan drangs/ rdo rje la thim/ badzra sa ma dzāḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥsangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir// rdo rje'i dbang ni bskur bar gyi// ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kun gyis khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yi// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐// padma lag tu gtad de/ padma mkha' 'gro 'dod chags rnam dag pa// 'du shes gnas gyur sor rtog ye shes kyi// rang bzhin mi g.yo mchog gi dbang bskur bas// bde gshegs kun gyi gsung ni 'grub gyur cig /oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nā ye a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ dbang gi lha rnams slob ma'i lus la zhugs// bum chus gtor zhing bkrus la blugs// dri ma'i phung po nyon mongs dag /sku dang ye shes dbang rnams thob/ mgo bo'i chu las 'od dpag med kyi dbu brgyan par gyur// slob dpon gyi lte ba'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi phyag na/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin sgra grag bzhin pa'i dril bu bzung ba rnams spyan drangs/ dril bu la thim/ badzra sa ma dzāḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sangs rgyas kun gyi dril bu'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir// dril bu'i dbang ni bskur bar bya// ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kun gyis khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yi// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐//

ral gri lag tu gtad la/ las kyi mkha' 'gro phrag dog rnam dag pa// 'du byed gnas gyur bya grub ye shes kyi// rang bzhin mi g.yo mchog gi dbang bskur bas// bde gshegs kun gyi phrin las rdzogs gyur cig oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nā ye a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ dbang gi lha rnams slob ma'i lus la zhugs/ bum chus gtor zhing bkrus la blugs/ dri ma'i phung po nyon mongs dag sku dang ye shes dbang rnams thob/ mgo bor chu las don yod grub pa'i dbu brgyan par gyur// slob dpon gyi lte ba'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi phyag na/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin rdo rje dang dril bu bzung ba rnams spyan drangs/ rdo rje dang dril bu la thim/ badzra sa ma dzāḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mgo thog tu rdo rje dril bu mnyam po bzung la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ming gi dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir// ming gi dbang ni bskur bar bgyi// kye dpal rdo rje'i gsang mtshan 'di zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o// ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyi ni// lha rnams kun gyis khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yi// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ gri gug lag tu gtad la/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro gti mug rnag dag pa// gzugs phung gnas gyur chos dbyings ye shes te// rang bzhin mi g.yo mchog gi dbang bskur bas// bde gshegs kun gyi sku ni 'grub gyur cig oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nā ye a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ dbang gi lha rnams slob ma'i lus la zhugs/ bum chus gtor zhing bkrus la blugs/ dri ma'i phung po nyon mongs dag sku dang ye shes dbang rnams thob/ mgo bor chu las rnam par snang mdzad kyi dbu brgyan par gyur/

༈ / de nas brda bzhi'i dbang bskur ni/ mda' gzhu bstan nas/ 'di ni khyod kyi bskyed rim du thabs shes ya ma bral bar/ he ru kaḥsngon po sbas pa'i yab dang bcas pa bsgom pa la dbang ba'i brda yin no// phag mgo bstan nas/ 'di ni khyod kyis phag la gtsang btsog med pa bzhin/ rtog med ye shes bsgom pa'i brda yin no// ka pā la bstan nas/ 'di ni khyod kyi chos nyid gang du'ang mi gnas shing skye 'gag dang bral ba'i brda yin no// de nas rdo rje rgya gram bstan nas/ 'di ni khyod kyi bskyed rim mthar phyin pa'i tshe/ phrin las bzhi'i sems can gyi don gyis shig pa'i brda yin no// des bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi sgrib pa dag lam bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku 'grub pa'i skal pa dang ldan par byas pa'o// gsang dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul nas/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ kyai bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming kye dpal 'di zhes bgyi ba la/ de bzhin nyid kyi ye shes nam mkha' lta bu dang*/ rgya mtsho lta bu dang*/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po lta bu gang bar mdzad du gsol/ yongs su gang bar mdzad du gsol/ shin tu gang bar mdzad du gsol/ rgyas par bar mdzad du gsol/ yongs su rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ shin tu rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ smin par mdzad du gsol/ yongs su smin par mdzad du gsol/ shin tu smin par mdzad du gsol/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la// mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar// bdag kyang skyob pa'i don gyi phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol// ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// byang chub sras mchog dbang bskur ltar// bdag gi gsang ba'i sems rgyun gyi// dbang 'di khyod la bskur bar bgyi// dam rdzas 'o ma blud la/

ngag tu/ a ho ma hā su khaṃ/ bdud rtsi'i ro bde ba chen po la brten nas bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes sgoms shig des gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag lam rtsa rlung bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs spyod pa'i sku 'grub pa'i skal pa dang ldan par byas so// shes rab ye shes kyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ kyai bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming kye dpal 'di zhes bgyi ba la/ de bzhin nyid kyi ye shes nam mkha' lta bu dang*/ rgya mtsho lta bu dang*/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po lta bu gang bar mdzad du gsol/ yongs su gang bar mdzad du gsol/ shin tu gang bar mdzad du gsol/ rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ yongs su rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ shin tu rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ smin par mdzad du gsol/ yongs su smin par mdzad du gsol/ shin tu smin par mdzad du gsol/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la// mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar// bdag kyang skyob pa'i don gyi phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol// ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// byang chub sras mchog dbang bskur ltar// bdag gi shes rab ye shes kyi// dbang 'di khyod la bskur bar bgyi// sindhu ras dpral bar thig le byas la/ dam tshig gi rdo rje phag mo smin mtshams su thim pas/ dga' ba bzhi nyams su myong bas mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin nyams su myong ba'o// des shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob pas/ yid kyi sgrib pa dag lam rdzogs rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku 'grub pa'i skal pa dang ldan par byas pa'o// dbang bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul nas/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ kyai bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/

bdag ming kye dpal 'di zhes bgyi ba la/ de bzhin nyid kyi ye shes nam mkha' lta bu dang*/ rgya mtsho lta bu dang*/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po lta bu gang bar mdzad du gsol/ yongs su gang bar mdzad du gsol/ shin tu gang bar mdzad du gsol/ rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ yongs su rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ shin tu rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ smin par mdzad du gsol/ yongs su smin par mdzad du gsol/ shin tu smin par mdzad du gsol/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la// mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar// bdag kyang skyob pa'i don gyi phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol// ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// byang chub sras mchog dbang bskur ltar// bdag gi tshig dbang rin chen gyi// dbang 'di khyod la bskur bar bgyi// lag pa stong pa'i mthil bstan nas/ ci 'dug ci yang ma mthong ba ni chos thams cad ma skyes pa'i brda yin no// de'i steng du rdo rje bzhag la/ rdo rje gcig 'dug snyam na chos thams cad med bzhin du rkyen gyis de ltar snang ba yin/ ngo bo nyid ma skyes pa bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin no// des nas se gol gsum gtogs la/ sgra de rim pa gsum du byung ba yang ngo bo gcig yin te/ de bzhin du chos thams cad du ma ro gcig go// phyag rgya chen po'i gnas mchog nas/ byang chub sems dpa' spyod pa'i blo gros bzhugs/ de ni ming tsam brda tsam btags pa tsam/ de phyag rgya chen po bsam du med pa'i brda yin no// des dbang bzhi pa thob sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa dag phyag rgya chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras su ngo bo nyid 'grub pa'i skal pa dang ldan par byas pa'o// de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang zhu ba'i don du slob mas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dang*/ bdag la rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang dang rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/

zhes gsol ba btab nas/ slob ma rnams padma dang nyi ma'i steng du/ hūm̐ dang rdo rje las/ rdo rje 'chang dang rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog sngon mo rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin par gyur pa la bum pa'i dbang bskur ni/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni// khams gsum kun gyi phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ dbang gi lha rnams ye shes pa'i tshul du zhugs shing*/ spyi bor mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ me tog dor/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā/ rdo rje lag tu gtad nas/ hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rje thabs de kho na nyid kyi rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig zungs shig dril bu g.yon du byin nas/ a las byung ba'i dril bu shes rab de kho na nyid kyi dril bu gsung gi dam tshig zungs shig / 'khyud pa'i tshul du byed du bcug la/ 'khyud pa yum dang bcas pa kha sbyor gyi rim pas phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig zungs shig / dril bu dkrol du bcug rdo rje dang ni dril bu longs// shes rab lag pas yang dag 'khyud// rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor ba// de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur// 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang thob pa yin no// dbang bskur ba dang rab tu gnas pa dang slob ma bsdu bar gyis shig dam tshig gsum sngon du 'gro ba rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ngo*//

yang sindhu ra spyi bor byugs nas/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang spyi gtsug tu mi 'bral bar sgoms shig khyod kyi lha rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yin pas/ rtag tu mi 'bral bar lus sems rdo rje rnal 'byor mar sgoms shig rang gi lte ba'i sa bon las sngags phreng thon te/ mdun bskyed kyi lte bar zhugs/ zhal nas phyung*/ rang gi zhal du zhugs lte ba'i sngags phreng sa bon dang bcas pa la thim par gyur/ de nas phreng ba gtad de ngag tu rjes bzlos byed du bcug la rtsa sngags sogs bzlas su bcug bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sindhu ra mgrin par byugs/ bzlas pa'i rim pa rnams dang ma bral bar gyis shig sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba'o// dam tshig pa dang mchod pa dang*/ brtul zhugs dang sbyin sreg dang las bzhi rjes su gnang ba yang sbyin te/ rigs lnga mkha' 'gro phyi nang dang*// rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig rnams// khyod kyis legs par srung bar gyis// zhes brjod pas rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang rnams rdzogs par song ba'o// de nas dam tshig thams cad bsdus nas bsrung bar khas blangs te// bdag 'bul ba ni/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyid// deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du// khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na// khyed kyi slob mar bzung ba dang*// cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// zhes so// gtang rag tu maṇḍal phul nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ oṃ shrīḥbadzra wā rā hī sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ oṃ shrīḥbadzra wā rā hī sa pa ri wā ra pa dyaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ oṃ shrīḥbadzra wā rā hī sa pa ri wā ra puṣpe pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ oṃ shrīḥbadzra wā rā hī sa pa ri wā ra dhū pe pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ oṃ shrīḥbadzra wā rā hī sa pa ri wā ra ā lo ke pra tītstsha ye swā hā/

oṃ shrīḥbadzra wā rā hī sa pa ri wā ra ghandhe pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ oṃ shrīḥbadzra wā rā hī sa pa ri wā ra nai wi dye pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ oṃ shrīḥbadzra wā rā hī sa pa ri wā ra shapad pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ de nas bstod pa bya ba ni/ oṃ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo la phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags ma 'jig rten gsum yum gzhan gyis mi thub rig pa'i dbang phyug che// 'byung po thams cad 'jigs mdzad kun tu 'bebs ma rdo rje chen mo nyid// rdo rje gdan ma mi pham gzhan gyis mi thub dbang mdzad g.yo ba'i spyan// dug kyang skem par mdzad la 'jigs su rung ba'i khro mo gtsigs byed mo// skrag byed gsod byed rab tu 'byed par byed cing pha rol las rgyal ma// rnam par rgyal ma rmugs par mdzad cing rengs dang rmongs par mdzad pa mo// rdo rje phag mo rnal 'byor chen mo 'dod pa'i dbang phyug ma la 'dud/ ༈ bkra shis ni/ /rdo rje 'chang chen tilli nā ro dang*// mar pa mi la chos rje sgam po pa// phag mo gru pa rgyal ba 'bri gung pa// bka' brgyud bla ma rnam kyi bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig sindhu ra yi dkyil 'khor la// pha rol phyin drug chos 'byung zur drug sngags dang bcas// gsang sngags rgyal po bam̐ la sku gsung thugs kyis bskor// bden pa des kyang bde ba mchog la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig mtshan ldan phyag skyog ka pā lar// byin rlabs bde ba skyong mdzad chang sna bzhi yis bkang*// dug gsum 'joms mdzad 'chi med bdud rtsis rab gang ba'i// bden pa des kyang bde ba mchog la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig yid bzhin nor bu lta bu yis// 'bru bcud sman dang rin po che yi don ston pa// bum pa bzang po nyon mongs dug sel chu rgyun 'bebs// bden pa des kyang bde ba mchog la bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor las// phyag rgya chen po dpe don gnyis su ston mdzad pa'i// chos kyi sku la rgyan bdun ldan pa'i bkra shis gang*// bden pa des kyang bde ba mchog la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog

/ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de kun mkha' 'gros bzod par gsol// gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas// legs byas 'di la nyes gyur gang*// lus can kun gyi skyon gyur pa// de yang mkha' 'gros bzod par gsol/ yig brgya brjod/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzod// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// badzra muḥrang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs shing dam tshig pa rang nyid la thim par bsam/ yang na/ ye shes pa ras bris dang*/ sku gsung thugs la bstim/ dam tshig pa rnams la rang la bstim/ padma tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā/ bdag bskyed kyi thugs ka'i baṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud 'od du zhu mkha' 'gro ma bzhi la thim/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi yang gtso mo la thim zhing*/ gtso mo yang snying kha'i bam̐ la thim bam̐ yig khog pa mgo bo zla tshes nā da la thim zhing*/ nā da'ang mi dmigs par gyur/ thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis ro dang nyi ma'i gdan gsal ba'i lte bar/ oṃ baṃ dmar po/ snying khar haṃ yoṃ sngon mo/ mgrin par hriṃ moṃ dkar mo/ mgo bor hriṃ hrīṃ ser mo/ spyi gtsug tu huṃ hūm̐ ljang khu/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭ phaṭ dud kha rnams kyis mtshan par gyur/ byin rlabs rim par brgyud pa'i phyag len bzhin/ nor 'khrul med par 'khrugs pa sdebs te bris/ nyes pa mchis na mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bshags/ dge bas rdo rje 'chang dbang myur thob shog rje btsun ma'i byin rlabs kyi rim pa/ rje gong ma'i phyag bzhes ji lta ba las/ cung zhig rgyas par byas pa 'di nyid/ las dang po rnams dang phyi rabs pa rnams la phan pa'i phyir dang*/ 'bri gung gi sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa rnams kyis bskul ba'i ngor/

shākya'i dge slong ānanda dharma dhwa dza shrī bha dras/ gdan sa chen po 'bri gung 'og min gyi gtsug lag khang chen por/ yos kyi lo rgyal gyi zla ba'i dkar phyogs la sbyar ba'i ye ge pa ni gtsang pa rin chen rnam par rgyal ba'o/// /
